items.title: Should AI Pricing Change Require Action From Salesforce Stock Investors?
items.summary: Salesforce has changed pricing for its AI Help Agent, moving from per seat licenses to charging customers for each successful AI answer delivered. This shift puts more of Salesforce’s revenue opportunity on actual AI usage, tying cash generation directly to how often enterprises lean on automation. The focus now turns to how Salesforce’s usage based AI pricing could affect the broader investment narrative and its long term cash engine. Spot opportunities beyond Salesforce by scanning hand...
